questions.question: Who won the gold and broke the national record in the women’s 60m indoor hurdles at the Meeting de Nantes Métropole 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyothi Yarraji**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji** won **gold** in the **60m hurdles** at the **Elite Indoor Meeting** in **Nantes, France**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• She set a **national record** with a time of **8.04 seconds**, surpassing her own previous best of **8.12 seconds**.
 
• Yarraji broke the national record twice within hours: first clocking **8.07 seconds** in the heats and then improving it in the final.
 
• While her time was impressive, it fell short of the **7.94 seconds** qualifying mark for the **World Indoor Championships** in **Nanjing**, China (March 2025).
 
• Yarraji is the **reigning 100m hurdles Asian champion** and has previously won **gold in the Asian Indoor Championships** in 2024.
 
• Alongside her, **Tejas Shirse** clinched **bronze** in the men's **60m hurdles** event with a time of **7.68 seconds**. Shirse recently set a **national record** with a time of **7.65 seconds** in Luxembourg earlier this month.

questions.question: Which team won the Santosh Trophy 2024-25 by defeating Kerala in the final?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **West Bengal won the Santosh Trophy** for the 33rd time, defeating Kerala 1-0 in the final at Gachibowli Stadium, Hyderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Robi Hansda scored the only goal** in added time of the second half, capitalizing on Aditya Thapa's header into the box.
 
• Hansda finished as the tournament’s **top scorer with 12 goals**.
 
• The match saw intense competition, with Bengal narrowly missing free kicks in the 58th and 62nd minutes, while Kerala's late free kick went over the crossbar.
 
• Both teams had impressive campaigns, winning nine of their 10 matches and drawing one, showcasing their dominance.
 
• Despite Bengal's historical dominance, **Kerala had beaten Bengal in the finals of the 2017-18 and 2021-22 tournaments**.

questions.question: Which Indian state unveiled India’s first glass sea bridge connecting the Tiruvalluvar Statue and Vivekananda Rock Memorial?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Tamil Nadu unveiled a **glass bridge** over the sea, connecting the **Tiruvalluvar Statue** and **Vivekananda Rock Memorial** in Kanniyakumari, marking the 25th anniversary of the Tiruvalluvar Statue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Bridge Details**: The **77-meter long, 10-meter wide bridge** was constructed at a cost of ₹37 crore, providing reliable access between the two landmarks, overcoming previous transportation issues caused by rough seas and low tides.
 
• **Tiruvalluvar Statue Facts**: Standing at 133 feet, symbolizing the **133 chapters of the Tirukkural**, this statue represents Tamil cultural pride and embodies the philosophy of social justice. It was designed by sculptor **V. Ganapathi Sthapathi** and is renamed as the **Statue of Wisdom**.
 
• **Vivekananda Rock Memorial**: Located at the southernmost tip of India, it honors **Swami Vivekananda**, constructed in **1970**, featuring the **Vivekananda Mandapam** and **Shripada Mandapam**, which enshrines Devi Kanyakumari’s footprint.

questions.question: What rank did India achieve in the QS Future Skills Index 2025 for job market preparedness?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2nd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks second** globally, following the **US**, in preparing for future job market demands, particularly in areas like **Artificial Intelligence**, **digital**, and **green sectors**, according to the **QS World Future Skills Index 2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The index evaluates countries based on **four key indicators**: **Skills Fit**, **Academic Readiness**, **Future of Work**, and **Economic Transformation**.
 
• India secured **second place** globally in the **Future of Work** category, with a score of **99.1**, just behind the US.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** praised India's performance, highlighting the government's efforts to strengthen youth skills, foster innovation, and create opportunities for self-reliance.
 
• Despite this success, India faces challenges in aligning its **higher education** system with evolving **digital**, **AI**, and **green sector** demands. There's also a need for improved **industry collaboration** and **employment market readiness**.
 
• India’s **youth population** and **start-up culture** are key drivers of its growth, positioning the country well in the global digital and innovation landscapes. However, India scored lower on **Innovation and Sustainability**, signaling room for improvement in forward-thinking solutions and sustainable practices.

questions.question: How many years of diplomatic ties were marked by the unveiling of the commemorative logo by Indian President Murmu and Singapore President Shanmugaratnam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**60 years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India and Singapore marked 60 years of diplomatic ties with the unveiling of a special commemorative logo.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The logo unveiled by President Murmu and President Shanmugaratnam commemorates 60 years of diplomatic relations between India and Singapore.**
 
• **The design of the logo includes elements symbolizing both nations, including their national flowers (lotus and orchid) and the number 60.**
 
• Bilateral relations between India and Singapore have deepened across various sectors, including trade, technology, and skill development.
 
• Singapore is India's largest trading partner in ASEAN and a significant source of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Bilateral Trade__

 __
 
• Trade between India and Singapore expanded from USD 6.7 billion in FY 2004-05 to USD 35.6 billion in 2023-24, with Singapore being India's 6th largest trade partner.
 
 
 
• Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)__
 __
 
• Singapore was the largest source of FDI into India, with inflows of USD 11.774 billion in 2023-24. Cumulative FDI from Singapore has reached USD 167.47 billion as of September 2024.
 
 
 
• Skill Development and Technology Cooperation__
 
 
• India and Singapore have collaborated on skill development centres and are expanding cooperation in technology, digital health, and the green economy.

questions.question: Where did the 18th 'Suryakiran' military exercise between India and Nepal commence?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

__
 
• **18th Exercise Surya Kiran**: India-Nepal joint military exercise commenced on January 1, 2025, at the Nepal Army Battle School, Saljhandi, in the Shivalik ranges, and will run until January 13.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Objective**: The exercise aims to enhance **interoperability** in **Counter-Terrorism (CT) Operations**, jungle warfare, mountain warfare, and humanitarian assistance, focusing on **operational preparedness**, aviation aspects, medical training, and environmental conservation.
 
• **Personnel involved**: **334 Indian Army personnel** from the **11th Gorkha Rifles** are participating, alongside Nepalese forces.
 
• **Bilateral Relations**: The exercise strengthens **India-Nepal military ties**, following visits by **Chief of Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi** and **Nepali Army Chief General Ashok Raj Sigdel**.

questions.question: In September 2024, India surpassed which milestone in renewable energy capacity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**200 GW.**__

__
 
• **India achieved the milestone of 200 GW installed renewable energy capacity in September 2024, marking a 14% year-on-year increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana installed rooftop solar panels, boosting solar energy capacity to 94 GW.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• Targets include achieving 500 GW non-fossil fuel energy capacity and reducing carbon emissions by 1 billion tons by 2030.
 
 
 
• **National Green Hydrogen Mission**__
 
 
• Aims to position India as a global hub for green hydrogen production and export.
 
• Seeks to reduce carbon emissions and create over 6 lakh jobs by 2030.

questions.question: Name the initiative launched to empower elected women representatives from Panchayati Raj institutions:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0** programme was inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, New Delhi.
 
• The initiative focuses on empowering **elected women representatives** from Scheduled Tribes in Panchayati Raj institutions.
 
• It aims to enhance their understanding of **constitutional provisions, parliamentary procedures, and governance**.
 
• The programme seeks to foster **effective leadership** among women at the grassroots level to drive social and economic empowerment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj Institutions:** These local self-governance bodies play a crucial role in the development of villages and implementation of government schemes.
 
• **Participation:** Around 500 elected women representatives from 20 states and union territories participated in the programme.
 
• **Objective:** The programme aligns with the vision of a **self-reliant India (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** by empowering women to take leadership roles in governance.
 
• **Role of Women:** Women associated with Panchayats contribute to social and economic empowerment by disseminating the benefits of central government schemes at the grassroots level.

questions.question: Under which mission is MeitY collaborating with IITs for semiconductor skill development?

__
 
• **MeitY is collaborating with IITs and private colleges under the India Semiconductor Mission to train professionals for the growing semiconductor sector in India.**

• **The mission focuses on developing local expertise in semiconductor manufacturing and related materials.**
 
• **Training programs will cover specialty materials, gases, substrates, and equipment used in the semiconductor ecosystem.**

questions.question: Who was honoured with the 'Satyajit Ray Lifetime Achievement Award' at the West Bengal Film Journalists Association annual award ceremony?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparna Sen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Aparna Sen**, a renowned director, was honored with the **Satyajit Ray Lifetime Achievement Award** at the **West Bengal Film Journalists Association (WBFJA)** annual ceremony for her significant contributions to Indian cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• During her acceptance speech, **Sen** expressed gratitude and praised **contemporary Bengali filmmakers** such as **Srijit Mukherji** and **Atanu Ghosh** for carrying forward the rich legacy of Bengali cinema.
 
• **‘Manikbabur Megh’** won the **Best Bengali Film** award, and **Chandan Sen** received the **Best Actor** award for his performance in the film.
 
• **Srijit Mukherji** and **Debaloy Bhattacharya** were jointly awarded **Best Director** for their films **‘Badami Haynar Kabale’** and **‘Padatik’**. Mukherji's film **‘Oti Uttam’** received **Special Recognition for Technical Innovation**, with a special focus on the use of AI to replicate the voice of iconic actor Uttam Kumar.
 
• **Rituparna Sengupta** won **Best Actor** for her role in **‘Ajogya’**. **Abhinandan Banerjee** was named **Most Promising Director** for **‘Manik Babur Megh’**.
 
• **‘Khadaan’** received the **Most Popular Film** award, and **Dev** was named **Most Popular Actor**.
 
• **Anjan Dutt** won the **Best Screenplay** award for his work on **‘Chalchitra Ekhon’**.
 
• Other notable winners included **Amit Chatterjee** (Best Music Director), **Rathijit Bhattacharya** (Best Background Score), and **Kaushik Ganguly** (Best Lyricist for ‘Ajogya’).
 
• **Playback singer awards** went to **Timir Biswas**, **Rathijit Bhattacharya**, and **Antara Mitra**.
 
• The ceremony, held at **Priya Cinema**, paid tribute to **Raj Kapoor** on his **birth centenary**, with a theme around the circus industry, and featured the iconic song **‘Jeena Yahan Marna Yahan’** from **Mera Naam Joker**.

questions.question: Who recently assumed charge as the CEO of UIDAI while continuing as Additional Secretary in MeitY? (January 2025)

questions.question: What is the name of the portal launched by SEBI for market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) to report technical glitches?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**iSPOT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SEBI has launched a portal called iSPOT to report technical glitches by market infrastructure institutions (MIIs).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The iSPOT portal will be integrated into the SEBI Intermediary (SI) portal for easier access and reporting.**
 
• Starting from February 3, 2025, MIIs will be required to make their submissions related to technical glitches via this portal.
 
• The portal aims to improve data quality, traceability, and compliance monitoring related to technical glitches in MIIs.
 
• The iSPOT portal will also facilitate automated intimation and the submission of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports by MIIs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)__

 __
 
• SEBI is the regulator for the securities and commodity markets in India, ensuring market integrity and protecting investor interests.
 
• It is responsible for overseeing stock exchanges, mutual funds, and other market intermediaries in India.
 
 
 
• Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs)__
 
 
• MIIs include entities like stock exchanges, clearing corporations, and depositories that facilitate the functioning of financial markets.
 
• These institutions play a vital role in the securities market by ensuring transparency and smooth operations.

questions.question: Who is the author of the book "Homeopathy for Anemia", which highlights homeopathy's success in treating aplastic anemia?

questions.question: Which two initiatives were launched by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to empower unorganized workers and enhance employment generation?

options.text: Labour Welfare Microsites and Employment Guarantee Scheme
e-Shram Microsites and Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)
Digital Skill Development Program and Employment Index
National Skill Development Mission and Labour Integration Portal

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Shram Microsites and Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya launched two initiatives: e-Shram Microsites and the Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) to aid unorganised workers and enhance employment generation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The e-Shram Microsites are state-specific platforms that provide seamless access to Central and State government welfare programs for unorganised workers.**
 
• The Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) helps match labour market demand and supply by providing data-driven insights into occupations facing shortages.
 
• The OSI will aid policymakers and training institutions in aligning job seekers' skills with industry demands, bridging skill gaps in high-demand sectors.
 
• The initiatives are aimed at making the workforce future-ready and improving employment outcomes across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• e-Shram Microsites__

 __
 
• The e-Shram initiative aims to provide social security benefits to unorganised workers and improve transparency and efficiency in welfare service delivery.
 
• The microsites are integrated with the national e-Shram database and facilitate simplified registration for workers.
 
 
 
• Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)__
 
 
• The OSI is designed to provide real-time insights into labour shortages and help match job seekers' skills with industry demands.
 
• The index is based on data from the International Labour Organization (ILO) and quarterly data from the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS).

questions.question: Which film, directed by Kiran Rao, has been shortlisted for the Japan Academy Film Prize 2024 in the Best International Film category?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Laapataa Ladies**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• **"Laapataa Ladies"** (Lost Ladies), directed by **Kiran Rao** and produced by **Aamir Khan Productions** and **Jyoti Deshpande**, has been shortlisted for the **Best International Film** category at the **Japan Academy Film Prize 2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla will pilot Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4) to the International Space Station (ISS).**
 
• This mission is set to launch from **NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida** no earlier than spring 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shubhanshu Shukla** **will make history as the first Indian astronaut to visit the ISS aboard a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft.**
 
• The mission will be commanded by former NASA astronaut **Peggy Whitson**, with Shukla serving as the pilot.
 
• The mission is part of a series of private astronaut missions to the ISS, marking a new era of international space collaboration.
 
• This mission is a milestone for both ISRO and private space exploration, enhancing India’s space presence globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Axiom Space__

 __
 
• Axiom Space is a private space exploration company that facilitates commercial missions to the ISS.
 
• The Axiom Mission series is a key part of expanding private participation in low Earth orbit.
 
 
 
• SpaceX Dragon__
 __
 
• SpaceX Dragon is a spacecraft developed by SpaceX for cargo and crew transport to the ISS.
 
• It is used for NASA and private missions, featuring an advanced autonomous docking system.
 
 
 
• Gaganyaan Mission__
 
 
• India's first human spaceflight mission led by ISRO, scheduled to send Indian astronauts into space.
 
• The mission will demonstrate India's capabilities in human space exploration.

questions.question: Which city ranked eighth globally and secured the top spot in West Asia in the Global Power City Index 2024?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Dubai** has secured the **8th position globally** in the **Global Power City Index (GPCI) 2024** and remains the **top city in the Middle East (**West Asia) for the second consecutive year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **GPCI**, released annually by Japan’s **Mori Memorial Foundation**, evaluates cities based on **six key areas**: **Economy**, **Research and Development**, **Cultural Interaction**, **Livability**, **Environment**, and **Accessibility**.

questions.question: India ranked 4th in the Global Firepower Index 2025. Which country topped the Global Firepower Index 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ​**USA**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• India has been ranked **4th** on the **Global Firepower Index 2025** with a score of **0.1184**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United States** is ranked **1st** with a score of **0.0744**, followed by **Russia** and **China**, both with a score of **0.0788**.
 
• **India's ranking** has remained the same as in the 2024 index, and the **top 4 countries** have not changed.
 
• **Bhutan** is ranked at the **bottom** of the index at **145th** position.
 
• **Pakistan's ranking** has dropped from **9th** in 2024 to **12th** in 2025.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** evaluates **military power** based on **conventional capabilities**, not nuclear strength, covering over 60 parameters such as **manpower**, **natural resources**, **finance**, and **geography**.
 
• The ideal score is **0.0000**, indicating perfect military strength, which no country possesses.
 
• **India** was ranked **1st** globally in terms of **population reaching military age annually**.
 
• India was also ranked **2nd** in **population**, **available manpower**, and **vehicles**.
 
• However, India ranked poorly in areas like **oil consumption**, **natural gas consumption**, **coal consumption**, **external borders**, and **external debts**.
 
• India was ranked **145th** in the world for **helicopter carrier strength** and **mine warfare capability** in the sea.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** is released annually by **Globalfirepower.com** since 2006, comparing **145 countries** based on their **war-making capabilities** across land, sea, and air.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The top **10 countries** in the **Global Firepower Index 2025** are:

 
 
• **United States** - 0.0744
 
• **Russia** - 0.0788
 
• **China** - 0.0788
 
• **India** - 0.1184
 
• **South Korea** - 0.1656
 
• **United Kingdom** - 0.1785
 
• **France** - 0.1878
 
• **Japan** - 0.1839
 
• **Turkey** - 0.1902
 
• **Italy** - 0.2164

questions.question: Which country is home to the Tianshan Shengli Tunnel, the world’s longest expressway tunnel?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Tianshan Shengli Tunnel, the world's longest expressway tunnel, is located in Xinjiang, China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The tunnel, at 22.13 kilometers, is located in the Tianshan Mountains in Xinjiang, China.**
 
• It will significantly reduce the travel time between southern and northern Xinjiang.
 
• The tunnel is part of the Urumqi-Yuli Expressway and will help reduce travel from 7 hours to 3 hours.
 
• China invested in the tunnel to overcome the region's geographical challenges and boost transportation efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tianshan Mountains__

 __
 
• The Tianshan Mountains are located in Xinjiang, China, and are known for their extreme altitudes.
 
• The mountain range stretches for more than 2,500 kilometers across Central Asia.
 
 
 
• Urumqi-Yuli Expressway__
 
 
• This expressway connects Urumqi in northern Xinjiang to Yuli County in the south, facilitating regional trade and travel.
 
• The project is expected to be completed and fully operational by 2025.
